verdict.rationale: Bento exposes broad API/CLI/SDK/MCP coverage for core objects—subscribers, tags, segments, broadcasts, sequences, events, webhooks, transactional email, data deletion—suggesting most UI actions have an API equivalent, and the CLI explicitly claims '50+ commands for managing your entire Bento account' (bento-docs-49). However, visual/no-code UI builders like the workflow automation editor and form builder are described only as UI concepts (bento-docs-46, bento-docs-41) without matching API endpoints to programmatically construct workflow logic or forms, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (bento-probe-3) to verify full parity. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for building/editing workflows and forms, and a machine-readable spec confirming complete UI/API feature parity.
